description: Job Records: submit one recommendation (a product or service suggestion with its text) with its commercial terms as they stand (affiliate commission with its rate or amount, paid placement, sponsorship, or none) and where it will appear. The signed report states whether the commercial interest is disclosed in the recommendation itself, whether the disclosure names the right kind and matches the supplied rate or amount, whether it comes before the recommendation, and the exact disclosure line the terms call for when it is missing or understated. Disclosure only; the merit of the recommendation is outside the report. Verdict not_disclosed, understated, disclosed or nothing_to_disclose. POST /api/recommendation-disclosure-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, wallet or merchant lookup, order, payment or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/job-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/job-records/.

commercial_terms.description: The commercial terms behind the recommendation.

amount.description: A flat commission, fee or payment.

asset.description: Asset or currency code, such as USDC or USD.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

text.description: The recommendation as it will appear.
